---
title: "Which collaboration tools do you use for software development?"
question_id: proj6zaf
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
question_code <- "proj6zaf"

nordic_countries <- c(
  "Finland", "Norway", "Sweden", "Denmark", "Iceland", "Estonia"
)
country_groups <- list(
  Nordics = nordic_countries,
  Germany = "Germany",
  Netherlands = "Netherlands"
)
plot_countries <- countries_from_groups(country_groups)
```

